newsitem.title: USA: Heist to delay Ablest spin-off, IPO.
newsitem.headline: Heist to delay Ablest spin-off, IPO.

text.p: C.H. Heist Corp said on Wednesday it would delay the planned spin-off of its Ablest Service Corp unit through initial public offering until later this year.
The company said market conditions were unfavorable for an IPO of its size. Based on the investment bank advice, it decided to wait.

President C.H. Heist said: "Ablest will continue to aggressively pursue acquisitions and open new offices in strategic markets where the company currently does not have a presence." He said that should provide critical mass needed to complete an IPO on terms originally planned.
Ablest is a temporary staffing company. C.H. Heist Corp provides industrial services including cleaning, insulation and maintenance.
